rows.text: In the press-conference record 福田内閣総理大臣記者会見 dated 1 September 2008, Fukuda says he decided that day to resign (私は本日、辞任をすることを決意いたしました).

rows.text: In the same opening remarks (【福田総理冒頭発言】) he recalls that he took office as Prime Minister on 26 September (９月26日に総理に就任) the previous year, taking over from former Prime Minister Abe.
